name: Lara Bean
headline: Director of Partnerships @ Blue J
about: I design and lead partnership programs that drive scalable growth built on alignment, trust, and measurable impact. My focus is on creating frameworks that turn collaboration into real business outcomes, connecting strategy with relationships that last.

experiences.description: As the primary liaison for global partner relationships, I orchestrated comprehensive go-to-market frameworks tailored for integrated partners, driving the successful launch of new partnerships and rejuvenating existing ones to unlock their full potential across diverse markets. Spearheading global partner strategies, I achieved revenue growth exceeding 100% quarter over quarter while providing strategic guidance to regional teams for alignment with overarching objectives. Establishing joint business plans with key partners, I fostered mutual success and collaborated closely with product managers and efficiency leads to optimize critical KPIs, ensuring sustained operational excellence.

Led a comprehensive overhaul of the partner program, aligning it with organizational objectives and defining five key growth objectives. Implemented a tailored partner tiering system to incentivize productivity and fostered collaboration with internal teams to enhance partner and customer experiences. Utilized automated solutions to optimize underperforming channels and reallocated resources strategically. Revised partner agreements to align with vertical priorities, resulting in a high-value partner portfolio and exceeding quota attainment by 115%.

Led a high-performing team of channel managers. Developed and managed channel programs across diverse partner categories, including Alliance, Integrated, Affiliate, and VARs, focusing on recruitment, onboarding, and partner enablement. Conducted regular portfolio planning sessions to ensure alignment with strategic objectives and accountability. Designed and executed innovative channel sales strategies, including incentive programs and digital events, to maximize partner engagement and sales effectiveness. Developed comprehensive channel frameworks and playbooks, enhancing productivity across affiliate, alliance, and integration categories. Collaborated cross-functionally to align channel strategies with overall business objectives and elevate the partner experience.

Established, executed, and oversaw the Smooth Network Alliance Program (SNAP), encompassing the partner program, comprehensive partner and customer journeys, internal frameworks, policies, and supporting tech infrastructure. Collaborated with top-level executives to align the program with organizational vision, leading cross-functional teams to deliver partner-focused solutions. Cultivated key partner relationships, negotiating agreements for mutual success, resulting in a 175% increase in partner-referred revenue and a significant boost in partner productivity. Maintained a deep understanding of the competitive landscape to inform strategic decisions and drive portfolio development in the restaurant tech industry.
Managed and built book of business of key accounts. Sourced new, and built on existing, partner networks to increase ideal customer revenue channels

Operated in a dynamic team setting to develop and refine sales strategies for an evolving market landscape, navigating production constraints and orchestrating strategic pivots to align with feasible opportunities. Collaborated with industry experts to craft a competitive product strategy, leveraging limited resources to achieve optimal outcomes and drive success in a challenging market environment.

Successfully expanded and led a team from one to four members, driving growth and productivity amidst dynamic market and regulatory changes. Developed and executed sales strategies and reporting initiatives, resulting in an impressive 86% increase in sales revenue.

Directed the management of a diverse channel network encompassing importers, agencies, and distributors across North America, with a primary emphasis on the US market. Utilized strategic prioritization techniques to identify and cultivate key importers, driving impactful engagement and substantial sales growth. Implemented standardized sales initiatives to efficiently penetrate unmanaged distribution networks, resulting in a remarkable >200% increase in cases within a single year. Spearheaded strategic planning efforts to ensure optimal product-market fit, maximizing portfolio exposure and market penetration throughout the US.
Acquired a comprehensive understanding of SAAS, technology sales, negotiation, and communication, leveraging strong technology acumen.

Consistently surpassed sales targets for both on-premise and retail accounts through adept utilization of consultative selling techniques and robust relationship building and management skills. Orchestrated and executed the participation in over 30 beverage shows across four provinces, simultaneously managing account responsibilities and driving territory expansion.

Pioneered and refined successful in-home tasting events, subsequently expanding to encompass on-premise corporate events and strategic partnerships with preferred organizations. Proactively sought out mutually advantageous vendor partnerships, cultivating new and recurring revenue streams for both Paired and our valued vendor collaborators.
